local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local fld = workspace["b\007\010\007\010\007"]
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local old = root.CFrame
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
    5,
    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AFK
        Event:FireServer(true)
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("Seat") or obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
        obj:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(fld:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        local tween = TweenService:Create(root, tweenInfo, {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(obj.Position)
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

local returnTween = TweenService:Create(root, tweenInfo, {
    CFrame = old
})
returnTween:Play()
returnTween.Completed:Wait()
